inputs.objective: Independently validate the Form 144 proposed-sale supply mechanism at documentary/data-feasibility level only. Verify public-time clock, field sufficiency, overlap/dependence controls, size-normalization feasibility and distinction from Form 4/lockup work without reading returns.

allowed_actions: read the frozen hypothesis and pinned Legacy ledger
verify SEC Form 144 filing requirements, current electronic filing clock and structured fields
assess PIT issuer/security mapping, pre-event float/liquidity normalization and repeat-filing dependence
persist one EvidenceAssessment with PASS_TO_TEST_DESIGN, PARK_DATA or KILL_MECHANISM recommendation
forbidden_actions: optimize size thresholds, holding horizons or subgroups against outcomes
success_condition: One independent documentary EvidenceAssessment determines whether QUANT-FORM144-SUPPLY-001 is test-design ready, data-blocked or structurally invalid, without outcome access.
